figuren.FIG-ANDREAS: Andrew: a fisherman of about thirty-five, short dark beard, earth-coloured tunic with dark belt and an olive-green mantle.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-BRUEDER-JESU: The brothers of Jesus: three or four young men in sand-coloured robes with green sashes, similar haircuts.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-EINNEHMER: Collectors of the temple tax: two men in light robes with ochre over-garments, one holding a green money pouch.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-GAESTE: Wedding guests: men and women in light festive robes with golden-yellow over-garments, cups in their hands.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-HERODIANER: Herodians: men in light robes with purple mantles and gold hems, courtly.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-HOHEPRIESTER: Chief priests: older bearded men in fine white and blue vestments with turbans, one with a breastplate of twelve coloured stones.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-JOHANNES-JUENGER: Disciples of John: lean men in rough brown garments with fur collars and leather belts.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-JUNGFRAUEN-KLUG: Wise young women: three young women in light robes with golden-yellow head scarves, each holding a burning clay oil lamp.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-JUNGFRAUEN-TOERICHT: Foolish young women: three young women in light robes with grey-blue head scarves, each holding a dark, extinguished clay lamp.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-KRANKE: Sick people: men and women in plain light-grey garments, one with a head bandage, one lame on a crutch, one blind led by the hand.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-PHARISAEER: Pharisees: bearded men, head uncovered, in grey-blue robes with white prayer shawls over the shoulders, small prayer boxes on the forehead, tassels on the hem.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-SADDUZAEER: Sadducees: wealthy men in light robes with petrol-grey mantles, turbans and gold hems.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-SCHRIFTGELEHRTE: Scribes: bearded men in brown robes with light over-garments, carrying scrolls.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-STERNDEUTER: Wise men from the East: three travellers of different ages in indigo-blue robes with golden-ochre mantles and plum-coloured turbans.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-WEINBAUERN: Tenant farmers: rough men in earth-coloured work clothes with green sashes.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-ZWOELF: The twelve disciples: twelve men of different ages in earth-coloured tunics with dark belts and simple mantles, travelling staffs.
figuren.FIG-HERODES-ANTIPAS: Herod Antipas: a man of about fifty with a thin gold diadem, violet robe and dark violet mantle with gold hem.
figuren.FIG-HERODES-DER-GROSSE: King Herod the Great: an old man with a grey beard and a gold crown, dark red robe with a slate-grey mantle and gold hem.
figuren.FIG-HERODIAS: Herodias: a woman of about forty in a plum-coloured gown with gold jewellery: diadem, earrings, necklace.
figuren.FIG-JAIRUS: Jairus: a synagogue leader of about forty-five with a full dark-brown beard, a prayer shawl with tassels over his head.
figuren.FIG-JAKOBUS-ZEBEDAEUS: James son of Zebedee: a fisherman of about thirty, dark beard, earth-coloured tunic with dark belt and a petrol-blue mantle.
figuren.FIG-JOHANNES-ZEBEDAEUS: John son of Zebedee: a young man of about twenty, beardless, short hair, earth-coloured tunic with dark belt and a dove-blue mantle.
figuren.FIG-JUDAS-ISKARIOT: Judas Iscariot: a man of about thirty-five, dark beard, earth-coloured tunic with dark belt and a grey-blue mantle, a small money box at his belt.
figuren.FIG-MATTHAEUS: Matthew: a tax collector of about forty, neat beard, earth-coloured tunic with a steel-blue mantle.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BAUM-FAUL: A diseased tree: olive-brown crown with holes, a crack in the trunk, rotten brown fruits.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BECHER-SCHMUTZIG: A cup polished shiny white outside, but with brown stains and streaks inside.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BROTE-FISCHE: Round flat loaves of barley bread and small dried fish.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-DENAR: A small silver Roman denarius coin with an emperor's head in profile.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-DORNENKRONE: A woven wreath of dark thorny twigs.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-FLOETE: A simple wooden flute with finger holes.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GOLD-WEIHRAUCH-MYRRHE: Three gifts: a small open chest of gold coins, a bowl with rising incense smoke, a small jar of myrrh.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-HAHN: A white rooster with a red comb, crowing.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-HENNE: A brown hen with small yellow chicks under her wings.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-LAMPE-AUS: A flat clay oil lamp without flame, a thin grey smoke thread above the charred wick.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-MATTE: A woven straw sleeping mat, rolled.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-NETZ: A fishing net with fine meshes.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-PERLE-KOSTBAR: A single large shining white pearl.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-ROHR: A long green reed with nodes and a pale plume at the top.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SALBGEFAESS: A slender cream-white alabaster jar with a narrow neck.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SENFSTAUDE: A large mustard shrub, tall as a small tree, with small birds in its branches.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-TISCH-UMGESTOSSEN: A wooden money-changer's table tipped over on its side.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-UNKRAUT: Darnel weeds: dark green stalks with almost black, drooping ears.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-WASCHSCHUESSEL: A flat basin of water with a linen towel over its rim.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-ZWEIG: Green leafy branches and palm fronds.
figuren.FIG-ORT-GRAB-GETUENCHT: A whitewashed tomb with a domed roof, bright and decorated outside.
figuren.FIG-ORT-HAUS-FELS: A cube-shaped flat-roofed house standing firmly on grey rock.
figuren.FIG-ORT-HAUS-SAND: A cube-shaped flat-roofed house on sand, collapsing.
figuren.FIG-PILATUS: Pontius Pilate: a Roman governor of about fifty-five with greying short hair, clean-shaven, in a white toga with a purple border.
figuren.FIG-RAHEL: Rachel: a mourning woman in an old-rose-brown robe with a dark violet head scarf.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-AUSSAETZIGER: A man with leprosy: dishevelled hair, torn and patched simple robe, a cloth over his mouth; no sores shown.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-BESESSENER: A man who was possessed: plain grey robe, unkempt hair, full beard.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-FRAU-BLUTFLUSS: A woman of about forty with a muted violet head scarf and a plain robe.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-GUTSHERR: A landowner: a man of about fifty in a light robe with a dark red mantle and headband.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-HEUCHLER: A showy man in a clean festive robe with a violet mantle.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-JUENGER: A disciple: a man in an earth-coloured robe with a belt and a travelling staff.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-KRANKER: A sick man: plain garment, head bandage, lying on a straw mat.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-MANN-HAND: A man in a light-grey robe without mantle; one hand is withered, pale with curled fingers.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-SCHRIFTGELEHRTER: A teacher of the law in a brown robe holding a scroll.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-ZWEITER-BLINDER: A second blind man in a blue-grey robe with a light belt.
figuren.FIG-SATAN: The devil: a dark smoky shadow without firm shape, floating, with two pale eyes; no horns, no grimace.
figuren.FIG-SCHWIEGERMUTTER-PETRUS: Peter's mother-in-law: an older woman with a light head scarf.
figuren.FIG-TOCHTER-HERODIAS: The daughter of Herodias: a girl of about fourteen in a pink dancing dress with a small tambourine.
figuren.FIG-TOCHTER-JAIRUS: Jairus' daughter: a girl of twelve in a light dress with loose hair, round childlike face.

1.note_de: Stammbaum und Ankündigung an Josef ([[MAT.1.1-MAT.1.25]]). Der Stammbaum ist als Baum mit Gesichtern gemalt (Abraham, David, Josef und Maria); der Engel erscheint Josef im Traum.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A great old tree whose branches carry small round faces of many generations: at the roots an old man with a long grey beard (Abraham), in the middle a crowned king with a harp (David), at the top a young couple, Joseph and Mary, with a newborn baby. Warm, calm, much empty paper.
felder.kern_en: Does a tree show faces of generations, from an old man at the roots to a young couple with a baby at the top?
felder.kern_de: Stammbaum von Abraham bis Josef und Maria

ausnahmen.de: Kindheitsgeschichte: Maria ist eine junge Mutter, keine Generation älter als ein erwachsener Jesus.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. At night Joseph, a man of about thirty, sleeps on a mat in a simple room; above him, softly drawn, an angel in white speaks to him in his dream. In a second, quieter part of the picture Mary, young and expecting a child, stands at a doorway. Medium shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a figure in white appear to a sleeping man?
felder.kern_de: Eine Gestalt in Weiss erscheint dem schlafenden Josef

ausnahmen.de: Kindheitsgeschichte: Maria ist eine junge Mutter, keine Generation älter als ein erwachsener Jesus.

2.note_de: Sterndeuter, Flucht, Kindermord und Rückkehr nach Nazaret in vier Feldern ([[MAT.2.1-MAT.2.23]]). Der Kindermord wird nicht gezeigt, nur die Klage Rahels.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Inside a simple house at night three wise men from the East in rich foreign robes kneel before Mary, who holds the infant Jesus on her lap; they offer gifts: a small chest of gold, a bowl with incense smoke, a jar of myrrh. Above the house a single bright star.
felder.kern_en: Do three foreign men kneel with gifts before a woman holding a baby, under a star?
felder.kern_de: Die Sterndeuter beten das Kind an

ausnahmen.de: Kindheitsgeschichte: Maria ist eine junge Mutter, keine Generation älter als ein erwachsener Jesus.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Under a dark night sky Joseph leads a donkey on which Mary sits holding the baby wrapped in cloth; they travel on a desert road towards the south, a few palm trees and distant pyramids on the horizon. Moonlight, deep blue night.
felder.kern_en: Does a man lead a woman with a baby on a donkey through the night towards Egypt?

ausnahmen.de: Kindheitsgeschichte: Maria ist eine junge Mutter, keine Generation älter als ein erwachsener Jesus.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Outside the small town of Bethlehem a woman in a dark veil sits on the ground and weeps with her face in her hands, other mothers grieving behind her; on a distant terrace an angry king with a gold crown turns away. No violence shown.
felder.kern_en: Does a woman weep bitterly near a small town while an angry crowned king is in the background, without any violence shown?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Joseph, Mary and the little child, now a toddler, walk on a road towards a small hill town with simple houses (Nazareth) in morning light; Joseph carries a bundle of tools. Wide shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a family with a small child walk towards a small hill town?

ausnahmen.de: Kindheitsgeschichte: Maria ist eine junge Mutter, keine Generation älter als ein erwachsener Jesus.

3.note_de: Johannes tauft am Jordan, Jesus wird getauft ([[MAT.3.1-MAT.3.17]]). Gott wird nicht gemalt; die Stimme aus dem Himmel zeigt das Bild nur am geöffneten Himmel und der Taube.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. John the Baptist, a lean man with long wild hair and beard in a rough camel-hair garment with a leather belt, stands knee-deep in the Jordan river and calls out; men and women from the city wait on the bank, one is being baptised. Reeds, wide calm water.
felder.kern_en: Does a man in a rough camel-hair garment stand in a river and baptise people while a crowd waits?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) rises from the Jordan river after his baptism; John stands beside him in the water. Above, the sky opens with soft light and a white dove descends towards Jesus. No figure of God, no halo.
felder.kern_en: Does a dove come down from an opened sky upon a man rising out of a river?
felder.kern_de: Taufe Jesu, die Taube kommt herab

4.note_de: Versuchung, Aufbruch in Galiläa, Berufung und Heilungen ([[MAT.4.1-MAT.4.25]]). Der Teufel ist als dunkle Gestalt ohne Hörner angedeutet.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. On a high bare mountain Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands upright and turns away with a firm gesture from a dark, shadowy figure without horns who points down to distant cities and kingdoms. Wide desert landscape below.
felder.kern_en: Does a man on a high mountain turn away firmly from a dark shadowy figure pointing to kingdoms below?

ausnahmen.de: Der Teufel ist als formloser Schatten gemalt (FIG-SATAN); fehlende Glieder sind gewollt.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) walks into a Galilean village at dawn; people come out of dark doorways into the warm morning light and listen to him. The light breaks over the hills behind.
felder.kern_en: Do people come out of dark houses into morning light to listen to a man walking into the village?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. At the shore of the Sea of Galilee Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) calls two fishermen, Peter and Andrew, who stand in shallow water with a casting net; they drop the net and turn to follow him. Small boat, calm lake.
felder.kern_en: Do two fishermen with a net turn to follow a man calling them from the shore?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) lays his hand on a sick man lying on a mat; around him many sick people – a lame man on crutches, a blind woman led by a child – are brought to him by a crowd.
felder.kern_en: Does a man heal sick people who are brought to him by a crowd?

5.note_de: Bergpredigt I: Seligpreisungen, Salz und Licht, Gesetz, «Ich aber sage euch» ([[MAT.5.1-MAT.5.48]]). Lehre ist als Hörende auf dem Berg gemalt; die Bildworte (Licht auf dem Leuchter) stehen für sich.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) sits on a green hillside and teaches; before him sit poor people, a grieving woman, children and disciples, listening with hope. Spring grass and flowers, the lake far below.
felder.kern_en: Does a man sit on a green hill teaching poor and grieving people who listen?
felder.kern_de: Jesus lehrt auf dem Berg: Selig sind

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A small clay oil lamp burns brightly on a tall lampstand inside a simple house, lighting the whole room; through the window a town on a hill glows in the evening. A few disciples sit in the warm light.
felder.kern_en: Does a lamp on a lampstand light a room, with a lit town on a hill outside?
felder.kern_de: Licht auf dem Leuchter, Stadt auf dem Berg

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands beside an open scroll of the Law held by a disciple and points to a single small letter on it; disciples listen. Simple, quiet composition.
felder.kern_en: Does a man point to a small letter on an open scroll while disciples listen?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) teaches disciples; in front of him a man stretches out his hand to an enemy who has wronged him and offers him his cloak as well – reconciliation instead of revenge. Calm faces.
felder.kern_en: Does a man offer his hand and cloak to an opponent while a teacher looks on?

6.note_de: Bergpredigt II: im Verborgenen, Vaterunser, Schätze, Sorgen ([[MAT.6.1-MAT.6.34]]).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Contrast in one picture: on the left a showy man in fine robes gives alms on a street corner while a servant blows a trumpet and people stare; on the right a woman alone in a small inner room kneels quietly in prayer, door closed.
felder.kern_en: Is there a showy man giving alms with a trumpet on one side and a person praying alone in a closed room on the other?
felder.kern_de: Vor den Leuten oder im Verborgenen

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) and his disciples kneel together in a row on a hillside, eyes closed, open hands lifted upward in prayer; no table, no food anywhere.
felder.kern_en: Do a man and his disciples kneel in a row praying with lifted open hands, without any food?
felder.kern_de: Jesus und die Jünger knien und beten

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A treasure chest on the ground eaten by moth and rust, a thief breaking in at the back; above it a clear sky. Next to it a disciple looks up instead. Simple contrast.
felder.kern_en: Is there a rusty treasure chest with a thief breaking in, and a person looking up to the sky?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) sits in a meadow with disciples and points to birds flying overhead and to wild lilies blooming in the grass; the disciples look, calm and relieved.
felder.kern_en: Does a man point to birds in the sky and lilies in the field while disciples look?

7.note_de: Bergpredigt III: Richten, Bitten, Goldene Regel, Haus auf Fels ([[MAT.7.1-MAT.7.29]]). Die Bildworte sind wörtlich gemalt (Balken und Splitter, Haus auf Fels und Sand).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Two men face each other: one with a huge wooden beam sticking out of his eye points eagerly at a tiny splinter in the other man's eye. Gently humorous but not a caricature.
felder.kern_en: Does a man with a large beam in his eye point at a small splinter in another man's eye?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A father kneels in front of his small son and places a round loaf of bread into the child's outstretched hands; beside them on the ground lies a big grey stone, clearly not given.
felder.kern_en: Does a father put a loaf of bread into his child's hands, with a stone lying beside them?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Storm and flood: on the left a house built on rock stands firm in the rain; on the right a house on sand collapses into the rushing water. Dark brown and grey storm, one clear contrast.
felder.kern_en: Does one house on rock stand firm while another house on sand collapses in a flood?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands on the mountainside at the end of his teaching; a large crowd below looks up at him astonished, some talking to each other in amazement.
felder.kern_en: Does a large astonished crowd look up at a man on a mountainside?
felder.kern_de: Die Menge staunt über seine Lehre

8.note_de: Heilungen, Nachfolge, Sturmstillung und die Besessenen von Gadara ([[MAT.8.1-MAT.8.34]]).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) touches a kneeling man with leprosy, wrapped in rags; in the background a Roman centurion in armour waits respectfully with bowed head.
felder.kern_en: Does a man touch a kneeling leper while a Roman officer waits nearby?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. In a simple house Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) takes the hand of an older woman lying on a mat; she rises, already well, and in a second moment serves food. Warm, quiet interior.
felder.kern_en: Does a man take the hand of an older woman who rises from her sickbed?
felder.kern_de: Die Schwiegermutter steht auf und dient

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A small fishing boat on the Sea of Galilee: Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands in the bow with raised hand; around the boat the high waves fall still, the dark storm clouds break up. Frightened disciples hold the mast.
felder.kern_en: Does a man stand in a boat raising his hand while a storm on the lake falls calm?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. In the foreground a large herd of pigs rushes down a steep slope and plunges into the lake, splashing; small in the background Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands with two calm men.
felder.kern_en: Does a large herd of pigs rush down a slope into a lake?
felder.kern_de: Die Schweine stürzen in den See

9.note_de: Vergebung und Heilung, Berufung des Matthäus, Tochter und Frau, Ernte ([[MAT.9.1-MAT.9.38]]).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A man who was lame walks away upright, carrying his large rolled sleeping mat on his shoulder; the empty spot where he lay is visible; Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) and an amazed crowd watch.
felder.kern_en: Does a man walk away upright carrying his rolled mat on his shoulder while people watch amazed?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) sits at a long table and eats with tax collectors and ordinary people; at the door a few Pharisees in fine prayer shawls look on disapprovingly.
felder.kern_en: Does a man eat at a table with many guests while disapproving religious men watch from the door?
felder.kern_de: Jesus isst mit Zöllnern und Sündern

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) holds the hand of a twelve-year-old girl who sits up on her bed, alive; her father stands by, overjoyed. In the background a woman touches the hem of a mantle.
felder.kern_en: Does a man hold the hand of a girl sitting up on her bed while her father rejoices?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands at the edge of a wide golden grain field ready for harvest and looks at it with compassion; only two or three workers stand in it. Two men who were blind walk beside him, seeing.
felder.kern_en: Does a man look at a wide ripe grain field with very few workers?

10.note_de: Berufung und Aussendung der Zwölf ([[MAT.10.1-MAT.10.42]]). Die Bildworte (Schafe unter Wölfen, Becher Wasser) stehen für die Rede.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands in the middle of twelve men of different ages in simple robes who stand in a half-circle around him; he lays his hands on the first of them, giving them authority.
felder.kern_en: Does a man stand among twelve men in a half-circle and lay his hand on one of them?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Two disciples walk out of a village gate along a dusty road with only a staff each, no bag; one turns back and shakes the dust off his sandals. Wide landscape.
felder.kern_en: Do two men leave a village, one shaking the dust off his sandals?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A small group of white sheep stands close together in the middle of a dry plain while grey wolves circle around them at a distance; a calm shepherd figure is absent – only sheep and wolves.
felder.kern_en: Do sheep stand close together surrounded by wolves?

ausnahmen.de: Keine Person im Bild (nur Schafe und Wölfe).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. At a house door a woman hands a cup of cold water to a tired travelling disciple with a staff; both smile. Simple, warm.
felder.kern_en: Does a person at a door give a cup of water to a tired traveller?

11.note_de: Täuferfrage, Spiel der Kinder, Wehe den Städten, Einladung ([[MAT.11.1-MAT.11.30]]).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Two disciples of John in rough garments ask Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) a question; around him a blind man is seeing and a lame man walks again – the answer is visible.
felder.kern_en: Do two men ask a man a question while healed people are seen around him?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. In a market place a group of children sits on the ground; one plays a flute, but the other children sit with crossed arms and do not dance. Playful, light.
felder.kern_en: Does a child play a flute in a market while the other children refuse to dance?
felder.kern_de: Wir haben euch auf der Flöte gespielt

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands on a hill and looks sadly at three small lakeside towns below, raising one hand in warning. Clouds over the towns.
felder.kern_en: Does a man look sadly at towns below, raising his hand in warning?

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stretches out his open arms to tired people; a man carrying a heavy load on his back looks up with relief as the load slides off. Green meadow, rest.
felder.kern_en: Does a man open his arms to tired people, and one man's heavy load slides off?

12.note_de: Sabbatstreit, Geist Gottes, Baum und Frucht, wahre Familie ([[MAT.12.1-MAT.12.50]]).

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. In a synagogue Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) says to a man with a withered hand: stretch it out – the man stretches out a healed hand; Pharisees in fine prayer shawls watch angrily.
felder.kern_en: Does a man stretch out his healed hand while angry religious men watch?

ausnahmen.de: Pharisäer tragen im Bildlexikon einen Gebetsmantel mit Streifen (FIG-GRUPPE-PHARISAEER); Streifen gehören hier dazu.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. A dark smoky shadow leaves a man and flies away, the man looks up freed and relieved; Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) stands before him with raised hand; Pharisees whisper behind their hands.
felder.kern_en: Does a dark shadow leave a man who looks freed, while a man raises his hand and others whisper?
felder.kern_de: Jesus treibt den bösen Geist aus

ausnahmen.de: Pharisäer tragen im Bildlexikon einen Gebetsmantel mit Streifen (FIG-GRUPPE-PHARISAEER); Streifen gehören hier dazu.

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Two trees side by side: a healthy tree full of red fruit and a rotten, bare tree with a few bad, dark fruits. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) points to them for teachers of the law.
felder.kern_en: Are there a good tree with fruit and a bad bare tree, with a man pointing to them?
felder.kern_de: An der Frucht erkennt man den Baum

felder.bild_en: Galilee and Judea, 1st century AD. Jesus (a man of about thirty in a white robe and terracotta-red mantle) sits in a house among his disciples and points to them; at the door outside, his mother Mary and his brothers wait.
felder.kern_en: Does a man point to his disciples while his mother and brothers wait at the door?
